errors.text: The predicted collapse of the HCP atom fraction above 900 K conflicts with the target result that HCP atom count increases with temperature.
Localized amorphization, Lomer-Cottrell lock annihilation, chemical short-range-order breakdown, adhesive wear, and material transfer are asserted without direct evidence from the specified system.
The cited evidence concerns tensile deformation of Ag and CoNiCrFeMn nanowires and does not validate the proposed mechanism in an indented FeNiCrCoCu/Cu coating.
